key_insight: HierSTT forecasts emergency department demand coherently across hospital, regional, and national levels in one end-to-end hierarchical Transformer model.
engineering_relevance: The approach can support staffing, bed allocation, and capacity planning by producing forecasts that stay consistent across operational decision levels.
method: Uses a Temporal Fusion Transformer to model national-level dynamics.
Uses spatio-temporal Transformer encoder-decoder modules for regional and hospital forecasts conditioned on higher-level predictions.
Adds a coherence-aware loss to reduce inconsistencies between hierarchy levels.
evidence_signal: The paper introduces a nationwide Portuguese ED dataset with 81 hospitals across 5 regional health administrations and reports a 32% average WAPE reduction versus the best non-hierarchical deep learning baseline.
watch_item: Performance depends on heterogeneous covariates and hierarchical data quality, so deployment may require careful data alignment and missing-data handling across hospitals and regions.
paper_title: Hierarchical Spatio-Temporal Transformer for Coherent Emergency Department Forecasting
